config.graph_input: original 64D training pixels / 16, before PCA; no test samples
config.primary_geometry: Euclidean-orthonormal learned 2D subspace via QR in shared PCA coordinates
config.native_geometry: method-specific native coordinate normalization, saved separately
config.query_rule: smallest original test ID with label 1, fixed before fitting
config.selection: no parameter sweep; no test-based method/query/class selection
config.scope: controlled three-class 2D teaching diagnostic, not original-paper or prior round2 benchmark

methods.name: PCA
methods.formula: maximize tr(W^T S_T W), W^T W = I
methods.meaning: Retain overall variance; labels do not enter fitting.
methods.geometry_note: QR changes axis scaling/geometry relative to native normalization. It preserves the learned 2D subspace.

methods.name: LDA
methods.formula: maximize tr[(W^T S_W W)^(-1) W^T S_B W]
methods.meaning: Separate global class means relative to within-class scatter.
methods.geometry_note: QR changes axis scaling/geometry relative to native normalization. It preserves the learned 2D subspace.

methods.name: LPP
methods.formula: minimize tr(W^T X^T L X W), W^T X^T D X W = I
methods.geometry_note: QR changes axis scaling/geometry relative to native normalization. It preserves the learned 2D subspace.

methods.name: MFA-1
methods.formula: maximize tr[(W^T A W)^(-1) W^T B W]
methods.meaning: Use labeled within-class neighbors and class-versus-rest margin pairs; MFA-1 GED surrogate.
methods.geometry_note: QR changes axis scaling/geometry relative to native normalization. It preserves the learned 2D subspace.

diagnostic_example.selection_rule: smallest original test ID where at least two method predictions differ
diagnostic_example.purpose: illustration only, not model/query/parameter selection or aggregate evaluation

lpp.selection: smallest eigenvalues with nonconstant coordinates; no unconditional first-vector skip
